extracted.name: Cauliflower Salad
extracted.description: This cauliflower salad is a bright, delicious side dish! It's a fresh twist on classic potato salad, featuring a creamy, tangy dressing, savory herbs, and hard-boiled eggs. Assemble the salad at least an hour before serving so that the raw cauliflower has a chance to marinate in the dressing.
ingredient_lines: 4 cups small cauliflower florets (from about 1 medium cauliflower, 1½ pounds)
Heaping ½ cup Pickled Red Onions
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, mustard, honey, garlic, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Add the cauliflower and stir to coat, then add the eggs, celery, pickled onions, capers, parsley, and dill and mix again.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour and up to a day.
Stir well and season to taste before serving.
